name: Italian Flat Tax for WooCommerce
author: Davide Mancuso

sections.description:
Italian Flat Tax for WooCommerce is a lightweight plugin that automatically applies a €2.00 stamp duty tax to orders that exceed €77.47 in WooCommerce. This plugin is designed to comply with Italian fiscal requirements and simplifies the checkout process by automating the application of this tax.

Key Features:
– Adds a €2.00 tax for orders exceeding €77.47.
– Fully compatible with WooCommerce.
– Easy to install and configure.
– Lightweight and optimized for performance.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv3. For more details, see the GPL license.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the italian-flat-tax-for-woocommerce folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. No additional configuration is required. The stamp duty tax will automatically apply to qualifying orders.
sections.faq:
What is the purpose of this plugin?

The plugin ensures compliance with the requirement to add a €2.00 stamp duty tax for orders exceeding €77.47.

Can I customize the tax amount or threshold?

Currently, the plugin does not support customization of the tax amount or threshold. Future updates may include this feature.

Does this plugin affect the checkout process?

No, the plugin seamlessly integrates with WooCommerce and automatically calculates the tax without disrupting the checkout process.
